# BMIAdjustment

This document merges every source file of the BMIAdjustment folder, which repeats the
main analyses with body mass index (BMI) taken into account.

The "MVMR" scripts run multivariable Mendelian randomization of BMI together with the
prioritized genes or proteins against obstructive sleep apnea; the "BMI_*_MR" scripts
run the BMI-to-sleep-apnea MR analysis (including the radial MR sensitivity analysis);
and the "SMR*_bmi" scripts run the SMR analysis of the same targets against a BMI GWAS
to test whether the target-BMI effect rather than the target-sleep apnea effect drives
the signal.

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

```{r "PlasmaPro_BMI_OSA_MVMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
outcome_dat <- read_outcome_data(

  phenotype_col = "Phenotype",
  sep = "\t",
  snp_col = "SNP",
  beta_col = "BETA",
  se_col = "BETA_SE",
  eaf_col = "FREQ",
  effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
  other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
  pval_col = "P",
  log_pval = FALSE,
  id_col = "id"
)

mvdat <- mv_harmonise_data(exposure_dat, outcome_dat)
mvmr_res_ivw <- mv_multiple(mvdat)
temp_res<-mvmr_res_ivw$result
temp_res$outcome<-"OSA"
for (i in 1:nrow(temp_res)) {
  if(temp_res[i,"exposure"]=="exposure1"){
    temp_res[i,"exposure"]<-gene
  }else{

  }
}

}

total_res<-total_res[-1,]
total_res$BETA<-paste(round(total_res$b,3)," (",round(total_res$b-1.96*total_res$se,3),"-",round(total_res$b+1.96*total_res$se,3),")",sep = "")
total_res$OR<-paste(round(exp(total_res$b),3)," (",round(exp(total_res$b-1.96*total_res$se),3),"-",round(exp(total_res$b+1.96*total_res$se),3),")",sep = "")

write.xlsx(total_res,"Path/MVMR/PlasmaPro_BMI_OSA_MVMR.xlsx")
```

```{r "BloodBrainGene_BMI_OSA_MVMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(ieugwasr)
library(stringr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: blood gene data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

dat<-fread("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood.tsv.gz")

setnames(dat,c("rsid","ref","alt","chromosome","beta","se","pvalue"),c("SNP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","CHR","BETA","BETA_SE","P"))


for (gene in c("ENSG00000116871","ENSG00000171055","ENSG00000076003","ENSG00000115159","ENSG00000106460","ENSG00000242435","ENSG00000241350","ENSG00000175164","ENSG00000133794","ENSG00000139428","ENSG00000110921","ENSG00000174373","ENSG00000141298","ENSG00000228782","ENSG00000169738","ENSG00000233622","ENSG00000131100","ENSG00000100395")) {
  
  temp_dat<-subset(dat,dat$gene_id==gene)
  
  if(nrow(temp_dat)==0){
    next
  }
  
  temp_dat$CHR<-as.integer(temp_dat$CHR)
  temp_dat$FREQ<-NA
  temp_dat$FREQ<-as.double(temp_dat$FREQ)
  temp_dat$maf<-as.double(temp_dat$maf)

  for (i in 1:nrow(temp_dat)) {
  if(as.double(temp_dat[i,"maf"])<0.5){
    temp_dat[i,"FREQ"]=1-as.double(temp_dat[i,"maf"])
  }else{
    temp_dat[i,"FREQ"]=as.double(temp_dat[i,"maf"])
  }
  }
  
  write.table(temp_dat,file = file.path(paste("Path/16.MVMR/QTL_data/BloodGene/",gene,".txt",sep = "")),sep = "\t",quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE)

}

outcome_dat <- read_outcome_data(

}

total_res<-rbind(total_res,temp_res)

}, error=function(e) {})

save.image(paste("Path/16.MVMR/Process_File/Blood_",gene,"_BMI_OSA_MVMR.RData",sep = ""))
```

## `BloodeQTLGenGene_BMI_OSA_MVMR.Rmd`

```{r "BloodeQTLGenGene_BMI_OSA_MVMR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: BloodeQTLGenGene_BMI_OSA_MVMR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(ieugwasr)
library(stringr)
library(eqtlgentools)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: cis-eQTL eQTLGen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

eqtlgen_cis_eqtl_df<-fread("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/2019-12-11-cis-eQTLsFDR-ProbeLevel-CohortInfoRemoved-BonferroniAdded.txt.gz")
eqtlgen_cis_eqtl_maf_df<-fread("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/2018-07-18_SNP_AF_for_AlleleB_combined_allele_counts_and_MAF_pos_added.txt.gz")

dat <- mutate_beta_se_from_zscore_eqtlgen_cis_eqtl(
  eqtlgen_cis_eqtl_df = eqtlgen_cis_eqtl_df,
  eqtlgen_cis_eqtl_maf_df = eqtlgen_cis_eqtl_maf_df
)

setnames(dat,c("SNPChr","SNPPos","AssessedAllele","OtherAllele","NrSamples","beta","se","Pvalue","AlleleB_all"),c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","N","BETA","BETA_SE","P","FREQ"))
dat<-dat[,c("Gene","GeneSymbol","SNP","CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","N","BETA","BETA_SE","P","FREQ")]
save(dat,file = file.path("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/cis-eQTLs-BetaSeFreqAdded.RData"))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: blood cis-eQTL eQTLGen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

load("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/cis-eQTLs-BetaSeFreqAdded.RData")

for (gene in c("ENSG00000116871","ENSG00000171055","ENSG00000076003","ENSG00000115159","ENSG00000106460","ENSG00000242435","ENSG00000241350","ENSG00000175164","ENSG00000133794","ENSG00000139428","ENSG00000110921","ENSG00000174373","ENSG00000141298","ENSG00000228782","ENSG00000169738","ENSG00000233622","ENSG00000131100","ENSG00000100395")) {
  
  temp_dat<-subset(dat,dat$Gene==gene)
  
  if(nrow(temp_dat)==0){
    next
  }

  write.table(temp_dat,file = file.path(paste("Path/16.MVMR/QTL_data/BloodGene/eQTLGen_cis-eQTL_",gene,".txt",sep = "")),sep = "\t",quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE)
  
  print(gene)

}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: trans-eQTL eQTLGen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
```

## `BMI_BloodGene_MR.Rmd`

```{r "BMI_BloodGene_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: BMI_BloodGene_MR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(plinkbinr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

target<-c("ENSG00000116871","ENSG00000171055","ENSG00000076003","ENSG00000115159","ENSG00000106460","ENSG00000175164","ENSG00000133794","ENSG00000139428","ENSG00000110921","ENSG00000174373","ENSG00000141298","ENSG00000228782","ENSG00000169738","ENSG00000233622","ENSG00000131100","ENSG00000100395","ENSG00000241350","ENSG00000242435")
target_name<-c("MAP7D1","FEZ2","MCM6","GPD2","TMEM106B","ABO","ARNTL","MMAB","MVK","RALGAPA1","SSH2","MRPL45P2","DCXR","CYP2T2P","ATP6V1E1","L3MBTL2","PMS2P11","UPK3BP1")

exposure<-read.table("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/BMI_allSNP_hg19.txt",header = T,sep = "\t")
exposure<-subset(exposure,exposure$P<5e-8)

row_file<-data.frame(exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,gene=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood/SleepApnea/blood_",target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","b"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta"))

  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["exposure"]][r] <- "BMI"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(exposure,gene,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".bmi",".ge"))
  flip_pro <- rename(exposure,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$BETA = 0-exposure$BETA
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,gene,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".bmi",".ge"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  if(nrow(input)==0){
    next
  }
  
  #format
  exposure_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.bmi",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "BETA",
                          se_col = "BETA_SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "P",samplesize_col = "N")
  exposure_format$exposure<-"BMI"
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(exposure_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-exposure_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 10000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.001,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(exposure_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-as.character(target_name[i])
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_BloodGene_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_BloodGene_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"BMI_BloodGene_row.xlsx")
rm(list = ls())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

target_name<-c("MAP7D1","FEZ2","MCM6","GPD2","TMEM106B","ABO","ARNTL","MMAB","MVK","RALGAPA1","SSH2","MRPL45P2","DCXR","CYP2T2P","ATP6V1E1","L3MBTL2","PMS2P11","UPK3BP1")

for (i in 1:length(target_name)) {

  if(file.exists(paste("harmonise_data/BMI_BloodGene_",
                       target_name[i],"_har.RData",sep = ""))){
    folder_path<-paste("mr_res/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],"/",sep = "")
    dir.create(folder_path)

    load(paste("harmonise_data/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],"_har.RData",sep = ""))
    
    if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))!=0){
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,            b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,                   intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
      
      if(nrow(subset(exp_out_har,mr_keep==TRUE))>2){
        exp_out_har_mrdeft<-mr(exp_out_har,method_list=                               
                              c("mr_ivw","mr_egger_regression","mr_weighted_median"))
        exp_out_har_mrhet<-mr_heterogeneity(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrplt<-mr_pleiotropy_test(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrsin<-mr_singlesnp(exp_out_har)
        exp_out_har_mrloo<-mr_leaveoneout(exp_out_har)

       #plots
       exp_out_har_scatP<-mr_scatter_plot(exp_out_har_mrdeft,exp_out_har)
       exp_out_har_scatP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_scatP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "_har_scatP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_sinP<-mr_forest_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_sinP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_sinP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "_har_sinP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_looP<-mr_leaveoneout_plot(exp_out_har_mrloo)
       exp_out_har_looP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_looP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "_har_looP.pdf",sep = "")))

       exp_out_har_funnelP<-mr_funnel_plot(exp_out_har_mrsin)
       exp_out_har_funnelP
       ggsave(exp_out_har_funnelP[[1]], 
           file=file.path(paste("mr_res/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "_har_funnelP.pdf",sep = "")))

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har_mrhet,
                                           plt =exp_out_har_mrplt,
                                           sin = exp_out_har_mrsin, 
                                           ao_slc = FALSE)
       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrallres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "/BMI_BloodGene_",target_name[i],
                                "_har_mr_allres.csv",sep = "")))

       ##subset for rbind
       exp_out_har_mrsubres<-exp_out_har_mrallres[-which(exp_out_har_mrallres$Method==
                                                          "Wald ratio"),]

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"outcome"]<-target_name[i]
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"exposure"]<-"BMI"
      exp_out_har_mr_bindres[1,"nsnp"]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
      all_res<-rbind(all_res,exp_out_har_mr_bindres)
    }
  }
}

#save all_res
all_res<-all_res[-1,]
all_res$Q_pval<-as.double(all_res$Q_pval)
all_res$Q<-as.double(all_res$Q)
all_res$Q_df<-as.double(all_res$Q_df)
all_res$intercept_pval<-as.double(all_res$intercept_pval)
all_res$intercept<-as.double(all_res$intercept)
all_res$intercept_se<-as.double(all_res$intercept_se)

all_res$BETA<-paste(round(all_res$b,3)," (",round(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se,3),"-",round(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se,3),")",sep = "")
all_res$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_res$b),3)," (",round(exp(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se),3),"-",round(exp(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se),3),")",sep = "")

write.csv(all_res,file = file.path("BMI_BloodGene_Radialmr_bindres.csv"))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path("BMI_BloodGene_Radialmr_bindres.xlsx"))
```

```{r "BMI_BrainGene_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: BMI_BrainGene_MR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(plinkbinr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

target<-c("ENSG00000171055","ENSG00000145194","ENSG00000164284","ENSG00000141458","ENSG00000267289","ENSG00000015475","ENSG00000100395")
target_name<-c("FEZ2","ECE2","GRPEL2","NPC1","CTD-2623N2.11","BID","L3MBTL2")

exposure<-read.table("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/BMI_allSNP_hg19.txt",header = T,sep = "\t")
exposure<-subset(exposure,exposure$P<5e-8)

row_file<-data.frame(exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,gene=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Brain_Frontal_Cortex_BA9/SleepApnea/brain_",target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","b"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","Beta"))

  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["exposure"]][r] <- "BMI"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(exposure,gene,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".bmi",".ge"))
  flip_pro <- rename(exposure,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$BETA = 0-exposure$BETA
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,gene,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".bmi",".ge"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  if(nrow(input)==0){
    next
  }
  
  #format
  exposure_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.bmi",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "BETA",
                          se_col = "BETA_SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "P",samplesize_col = "N")
  exposure_format$exposure<-"BMI"
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(exposure_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-exposure_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 10000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.001,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(exposure_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-as.character(target_name[i])
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_BrainGene_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_BrainGene_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"BMI_BrainGene_row.xlsx")
rm(list = ls())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)
```

```{r "BMI_BrainPro_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: BMI_BrainPro_MR.Rmd (R code)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)

# Chunk: setting
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

target<-c("ENSG00000099968.BCL2L13","ENSG00000119922.IFIT2","ENSG00000106460.TMEM106B")
target_name<-c("BCL2L13","IFIT2","TMEM106B")

exposure<-read.table("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/BMI_allSNP_hg19.txt",header = T,sep = "\t")

row_file<-data.frame(exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,gene=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ROSMAP/SleepApnea/",target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","Bp","A1","A2","se"),c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","SE"))

  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["exposure"]][r] <- "BMI"
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(exposure,gene,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".bmi",".ge"))
  flip_pro <- rename(exposure,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$BETA = 0-exposure$BETA
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,gene,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".bmi",".ge"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  row_file[["merge"]][r] <- nrow(input)
  if(nrow(input)==0){
    next
  }
  
  #format
  exposure_format<-format_data(input,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP.bmi",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "BETA",
                          se_col = "BETA_SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "P",samplesize_col = "N")
  exposure_format$exposure<-"BMI"
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(exposure_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-exposure_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 10000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.001,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(exposure_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(input,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP.ge",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-as.character(target_name[i])
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 1) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_BrainPro_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_BrainPro_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

#save file
write.xlsx(row_file,"BMI_BrainPro_row.xlsx")
rm(list = ls())

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res<-data.frame(Method=NA,outcome=NA,exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,b=NA,se=NA,pval=NA,Q=NA,Q_df=NA,Q_pval=NA,intercept=NA,intercept_se=NA,intercept_pval=NA,id.outcome=NA,id.exposure=NA,exp_out_har_pair=NA)

       #combine_all_mrresults 
       exp_out_har_mrallres<-combine_all_mrresults(res = exp_out_har_mrdeft, 
                                           het= exp_out_har_mrhet,

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrallres,file = 
                file.path(paste("mr_res/BMI_BrainPro_",target_name[i],

       write.csv(exp_out_har_mrsubres,file =

       ##transform list to data.frame
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-as.data.frame(exp_out_har_mrraps)

       ##rename colnames to merge
       setnames(exp_out_har_mrraps_re,c("beta.hat","beta.se","beta.p.value"),

       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$Method<-"MR RAPS"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$outcome<-as.character(target_name[i])

       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept<-"NA"

       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$intercept_pval<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.outcome<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re$id.exposure<-"NA"
       exp_out_har_mrraps_re<-exp_out_har_mrraps_re[,c("Method","outcome","exposure",                       "nsnp","b","se","pval","Q","Q_df","Q_pval","intercept",

write.csv(all_res,file = file.path("BMI_BrainPro_mr_bindres.csv"))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path("BMI_BrainPro_mr_bindres.xlsx"))
```

```{r "BMI_OSA_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}
```

```{r "BMI_PlasmaPro_MR.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: BMI_PlasmaPro_MR.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup

library(dplyr)

rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

target<-c("CALCOCO2","LCT","PCSK1")
target_name<-c("CALCOCO2","LCT","PCSK1")

exposure<-read.table("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/BMI_allSNP_hg19.txt",header = T,sep = "\t")
exposure<-subset(exposure,exposure$P<5e-8)

row_file<-data.frame(exposure=NA,nsnp=NA,gene=NA,merge=NA,format_row=NA,clump_row=NA,harmonise_row=NA)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: harmonise
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")
r<-0
for (i in 1:length(target)) {
  
  gene<-read.table(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ARIC/SleepApnea/",target[i],".txt",sep = ""),header = T,sep = "\t")

  setnames(gene,c("Chr","A1","A2","se"),c("CHR","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele","SE"))

  
  r<-r+1
  row_file[r,] <- NA
  row_file[["gene"]][r] <- as.character(target_name[i])
  row_file[["nsnp"]][r] <- nrow(gene)
  row_file[["exposure"]][r] <- "BMI"
  
  #format
  exposure_format<-format_data(exposure,
                          type = "exposure",header = TRUE,snps = NULL,
                          snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "BETA",
                          se_col = "BETA_SE",eaf_col = "FREQ",
                          pval_col = "P",samplesize_col = "N")
  exposure_format$exposure<-"BMI"
  row_file[["format_row"]][r]<-nrow(exposure_format)
  
  #clump
  clump_temp<-exposure_format[,c("SNP","pval.exposure")]
  pre_clump_data <- clump_temp %>% select(rsid = SNP,pval = pval.exposure)
  pro_SleepApnea_clump <- tryCatch({
    ld_clump_local(pre_clump_data,
                  clump_kb = 10000,  
                  clump_r2 = 0.001,  
                  clump_p = 5*10^(-8),  
                  plink_bin = get_plink_exe(),  
                  bfile = "Path/g1000/EUR") %>% {.$rsid}
    }, error=function(e) {})
  row_file[["clump_row"]][r]<-length(pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  clump <- subset(exposure_format, SNP %in% pro_SleepApnea_clump)
  
  #outcome/harmonise
  out<-tryCatch({
    format_data(gene,type = "outcome",header = TRUE,
                      snps = clump$SNP,snp_col = "SNP",chr_col = "CHR",
                          pos_col = "BP",
                          effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",
                          other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",
                          beta_col = "Beta",
                          se_col = "SE",eaf_col = "Freq",
                          pval_col = "p")
  },error=function(e) {})
  if(length(out)!=0)
    out$outcome<-as.character(target_name[i])
  
  if(length(out)==0){
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-0
  }else{
    exp_out_har<-harmonise_data(clump,out,action = 2) 
    row_file[["harmonise_row"]][r]<-nrow(exp_out_har)
    save(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_PlasmaPo_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.RData",
                         sep = "")))
    write.csv(exp_out_har,file = 
         file.path(paste("Path/BMIQTLSMR/harmonise_data/BMI_PlasmaPo_",
                         as.character(target_name[i]),"_har.csv",sep = "")))
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: MR
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/BMIQTLSMR/")

combine_all_mrresults <- function (res, het, plt, sin, ao_slc = T, Exp = F, split.exposure = F, split.outcome = F) 
{
    requireNamespace("plyr", quietly = TRUE)
    het <- het[, c("id.exposure", "id.outcome", "method", "Q", 
        "Q_df", "Q_pval")]
       sin <- sin[grep("[:0-9:]", sin$SNP), ]
    sin$method <- "Wald ratio"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "p"] <- "pval"
    names(res)[names(res) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(het)[names(het) == "method"] <- "Method"
    names(sin)[names(sin) == "method"] <- "Method"
    res <- merge(res, het, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    res <- plyr::rbind.fill(res, sin[, c("exposure", "outcome", 
        "id.exposure", "id.outcome", "SNP", "b", "se", "pval", 
        "Method")])
    if (ao_slc) {
        ao <- available_outcomes()
        names(ao)[names(ao) == "nsnp"] <- "nsnps.outcome.array"
        res <- merge(res, ao[, !names(ao) %in% c("unit", "priority", 
            "sd", "path", "note", "filename", "access", "mr")], 
            by.x = "id.outcome", by.y = "id")
    }
    res$nsnp[is.na(res$nsnp)] <- 1
    for (i in unique(res$id.outcome)) {
        Methods <- unique(res$Method[res$id.outcome == i])
        Methods <- Methods[Methods != "Wald ratio"]
        for (j in unique(Methods)) {
            res$SNP[res$id.outcome == i & res$Method == j] <- 
              paste(res$SNP[res$id.outcome == 
                i & res$Method == "Wald ratio"], collapse = "; ")
        }
    }
    if (Exp) {
        res$or <- exp(res$b)
        res$or_lci95 <- exp(res$b - res$se * 1.96)
        res$or_uci95 <- exp(res$b + res$se * 1.96)
    }
    plt <- plt[, c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", "egger_intercept", 
        "se", "pval")]
    plt$Method <- "MR Egger"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "egger_intercept"] <- "intercept"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "se"] <- "intercept_se"
    names(plt)[names(plt) == "pval"] <- "intercept_pval"
    res <- merge(res, plt, by = c("id.outcome", "id.exposure", 
        "Method"), all.x = T)
    if (split.exposure) {
        res <- split_exposure(res)
    }
    if (split.outcome) {
        res <- split_outcome(res)
    }
    Cols <- c("Method", "outcome", "exposure", "nsnp", "b", "se", 
        "pval", "intercept", "intercept_se", "intercept_pval", 
        "Q", "Q_df", "Q_pval", "consortium", "ncase", "ncontrol", 
        "pmid", "population")
    res <- res[, c(names(res)[names(res) %in% Cols], names(res)[which(!names(res) %in% 
        Cols)])]
    return(res)
}

all_res$intercept_pval<-as.double(all_res$intercept_pval)
all_res$intercept<-as.double(all_res$intercept)
all_res$intercept_se<-as.double(all_res$intercept_se)

all_res$BETA<-paste(round(all_res$b,3)," (",round(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se,3),"-",round(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se,3),")",sep = "")
all_res$OR<-paste(round(exp(all_res$b),3)," (",round(exp(all_res$b-1.96*all_res$se),3),"-",round(exp(all_res$b+1.96*all_res$se),3),")",sep = "")

write.csv(all_res,file = file.path("BMI_PlasmaPo_mr_bindres.csv"))
write.xlsx(all_res,file = file.path("BMI_PlasmaPo_mr_bindres.xlsx"))
```

## `SMReQTL_bmi_Rcode.Rmd`

```{r "SMReQTL_bmi_Rcode.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: SMReQTL_bmi_Rcode.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(openxlsx)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(data.table)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Read the blood mRNA SMR results
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())
setwd("Path/datasource/BMI_eQTL/")

results<-read.delim("Blood_bmi.smr",header = TRUE,stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

results<-results[which(results$probeID %in% c("ENSG00000116871","ENSG00000171055","ENSG00000076003","ENSG00000115159","ENSG00000106460","ENSG00000242435","ENSG00000241350","ENSG00000175164","ENSG00000133794","ENSG00000139428","ENSG00000110921","ENSG00000174373","ENSG00000141298","ENSG00000228782","ENSG00000169738","ENSG00000233622","ENSG00000131100","ENSG00000100395")),]
results$BETA<-paste(round(results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
results$OR<-paste(round(exp(results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")
write.xlsx(results,"ALL_Blood_bmi.xlsx")
results<-subset(results,results$p_SMR<0.05)
results<-subset(results,results$p_HEIDI>0.01)
write.xlsx(results,"Sig_Blood_bmi.xlsx")

write.table(results$probeID,"Sig_Blood_bmi_gene.txt",row.names = F,col.names = F,quote = FALSE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

results$BETA<-paste(round(results$b_SMR,3)," (",round(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR,3),"-",round(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR,3),")",sep = "")
results$OR<-paste(round(exp(results$b_SMR),3)," (",round(exp(results$b_SMR-1.96*results$se_SMR),3),"-",round(exp(results$b_SMR+1.96*results$se_SMR),3),")",sep = "")
write.xlsx(results,"ALL_Brain_bmi.xlsx")
```
